from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import json
p=Path('analysis')
files=sorted(q for q in p.rglob('*') if q.is_file())
for q in files: print(q,q.stat().st_size)
assert p.joinpath('initial.json').stat().st_mtime_ns < p.joinpath('probe-attempt-01.stdout.jsonl').stat().st_mtime_ns
source=sha256(Path('component.go').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for name in ('draft-verify.json','jev-results.json'): assert json.loads(p.joinpath(name).read_text())['source_sha256']==source
print('Initial snapshot predated first probe log; both model batches refer to the current source hash.')
